events.title: Welcome to the (Mini) Apocalypse, Night of the Idle Horde demo available now!
events.summary: Most apocalypse media tells you to barricade the house, stock up on supplies and aim for the head. But not this one! With Night of the Idle Horde we wanted to flip that on its undead, disembodied head by giving you control of a ravenous band of zombies to topple civilization.We’re huge fans of idle and incremental games, but also passionate horror fans so marrying the two is a no-braaaaaaaaainer.
